verdict.rationale: Unit's docs list wires and real-time payments (RTP) alongside ACH as supported payment rails through the same API (unit-docs-2, unit-docs-14), but FedNow is never mentioned anywhere in the evidence pack, and there is no per-rail documentation of capabilities (limits, timing, origination vs receipt) — probes even show the actual API docs/OpenAPI spec returning 404s. missing for 10: FedNow support, per-rail capability documentation (limits/cutoffs/return codes), accessible API reference confirming origination and receipt for each rail.
